title: Corrupted Soul
wikitext:
{{Passive skill box|Corrupted Soul}}

'''Corrupted Soul''' is a [[keystone passive skill]] which causes 50% Non-[[Chaos Damage]] taken to bypass [[Energy Shield]] and grants 15% of Maximum [[Life]] as Extra Maximum [[Energy Shield]].

==Mechanics==
'''{{c|mod|50% of Non-Chaos Damage taken bypasses Energy Shield}}''': 

This is especially useful if you have a source of both Life and Energy Shield [[regeneration]] or [[recovery]], e.g. the [[Inquisitor]]'s Ascendancy Notable {{psl|Pious Path}} which allows you to regenerate Life and Energy Shield simultaneously.

Example of a character with 3000 maximum Life and 3000 maximum Energy Shield:
*'''Without Corrupted Soul''':
**A monster hitting you for 1000 damage of any Non-Chaos Damage will reduce your Energy Shield by 1000. 
**Giving you the chance of recovering Energy Shield through any form of recovery but not Life because it is still [[full life|full]].
*'''With Corrupted Soul''':
**A monster hitting you for 1000 damage of any Non-Chaos Damage will reduce your Energy Shield by 500 and Life by 500. 
**Giving you the chance of recovering both Life and Energy Shield.

'''{{c|mod|Gain 15% of Maximum Life as Extra Maximum Energy Shield}}''': 

Example of how much Energy Shield this modifier grants a character with 1000 base maximum Life, 200% increased maximum Life, and 120% increased maximum Energy Shield:

*{{math|formula=
1000 \times \left (\frac {15}{100} \right) \times \left (1 + \frac {200}{100} + \frac {120}{100} \right) = 630 \text { maximum Energy Shield}
}}

==Location==
This keystone (via the unique jewel) will conquer (i.e. convert) any keystones within the jewel radius of {{il|Glorious Vanity}} (the variant {{c|mod|Bathed in the blood of (100–8000) sacrificed in the name of '''Doryani'''}} only) unique timeless jewel. Thus, this keystone can be acquired via any keystone of the skill tree that is near to a [[jewel]] socket. Note that the unique jewel cannot be placed in a jewel slot from a [[cluster jewel]].
